node.statement: Verification of the amplified four-corner clauses. Define gamma_UU=T_U, gamma_VV=T_V and gamma_UV=gamma_VU=the unique zero maps between the zero source and target cross-corners, with gamma_jk,n=I_n tensor gamma_jk. For diagonal inputs, the extended C_out*t-isomorphism clauses for T_U,T_V give involution compatibility, compressed-product compatibility, diagonal compressed-unit approximation, and the two-sided norm bounds at every amplification. If any input is off-diagonal, its source corner is zero, so it and every relevant source product are zero; the corresponding target map and target products are also zero, making the same clauses exact. Dagger merely exchanges the two zero cross-corners, as ensured by lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities. Hence all four fixed maps share the single defect rho=C_cross*t. Together with node 1.6, this is exactly an amplified four-corner merging datum in the sense of def-four-corner-merging-datum.
